sourceTitle: Stories of Boys and Girls Who Loved the Saviour A Token for Children
description: "Stories of Boys and Girls Who Loved the Saviour" by James Janeway is a collection of inspirational narratives centered around children who exhibited profound devotion to their Christian faith, likely written during the late 17th century. The book compiles various accounts of young individuals who, despite their tender ages, displayed remarkable spiritual depth and a passionate love for Jesus Christ.
